off_by_one.root_cause: copy_name allocates strlen(name) bytes and strcpy writes strlen(name) + 1, so the terminating NUL lands one byte past the end of the block.

underflow.root_cause: bucket_of returns -1 for a negative sample and build_histogram uses it as an index, writing hist[-1] before the start of the block.
underflow.fix: Clamp negative samples to bucket 0 in bucket_of (or validate the index before incrementing).

double_free.root_cause: handle_request frees req->body on its error path without clearing it, and release_request frees the same pointer again.
double_free.fix: Give the body a single owner: remove the free from handle_request's error path, or set req->body = NULL after freeing it there.

use_after_free.root_cause: evict frees the cache entry while main still holds a pointer to it, and record_hit then increments hits in the freed block.
use_after_free.fix: Do not use an entry after evicting it: look it up again, or record the hit before calling evict.

realloc_stale.root_cause: main keeps header = b.data, append grows the buffer with realloc which moves it, and the write through header lands in the freed old block.
realloc_stale.fix: Store an offset instead of a pointer into the buffer, or re-derive the pointer from b.data after every append.

interior_free.root_cause: process_line frees word, a pointer that skip_spaces advanced into the middle of the strdup'd line, instead of the pointer strdup returned.

free_stack.root_cause: When user is NULL, greet points name at the local array fallback and then passes that stack address to free.
free_stack.fix: Only free what was allocated: track ownership with a flag, or always strdup the fallback.

leak.root_cause: The strings returned by load_setting in main's loop and the table returned by make_cache are never freed.
leak.fix: Free each load_setting result after printing it and free the cache before returning from main.

null_deref.root_cause: find_device returns NULL for an unknown id and print_device dereferences the result without checking it.
null_deref.fix: Check the result of find_device for NULL in print_device and report the unknown id.

new_overflow.root_cause: make_squares loops with i <= n and writes squares[n], one element past the end of the new long[n] array.
new_overflow.fix: Use i < n as the loop condition (or std::vector with bounds-checked access).

thread_uaf.root_cause: worker_main frees the job after processing it, but submit_job writes job->status after joining the worker, so the write hits freed memory.
thread_uaf.fix: Define one owner: let submit_job free the job after setting its status, and do not free it in worker_main.
